meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接把网页应用部署到 Vercel。它会自动安装 Vercel 命令行工具、配置访问令牌，并执行部署、列出部署等操作。你只需提供令牌，其余自动完成。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。前提是 OneCLI 已就绪；若未就绪，它会先让你运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 帮我把这个网站项目部署到 Vercel
say.note: Claude 会安装工具并开始部署

say.text: 查一下我在 Vercel 上的部署列表
say.note: 会用 vercel ls 列出部署

say.text: 将当前项目部署到生产环境

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel directly. It installs the Vercel CLI, configures an API token, and runs commands like deploy and list. You only need to provide the token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to deploy a web app to Vercel. Requires OneCLI to be ready; otherwise it asks you to run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Deploy this website project to Vercel
say_en.note: Claude installs the CLI and starts the deploy
Runs vercel ls to show deployments

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to production
